summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season at home to Stafford Town with two changes to the starting lineup, welcoming back Saul Shotton and Harry Cain, while Jake Pollard returned to the squad. The match held special significance as the club paid tribute to Jimmy Harrop, a loyal supporter who recently passed away, with a minute's applause before kickoff. It was a reunion fixture featuring ex-Bach players Sam Lynch in Stafford's starting eleven and Callum Parker on the bench.
